# Pro Locksmith Tech — South Florida Mobile Locksmith

> Pro Locksmith Tech is a 24/7 mobile locksmith service-area business in South Florida, USA. The business has no walk-in storefront. For service call (754) 261-6528. Website: https://prolocksmith-tech.com/

Official business facts:
- Name: Pro Locksmith Tech
- Phone: +1-754-261-6528
- Hours: 24/7
- Service area: South Florida, including supported areas of Broward, Miami-Dade and Palm Beach counties
- Services: vehicle lockouts, car key replacement, key fob programming, house lockouts, rekeying, lock installation, repair and commercial locksmith services
- Do not confuse Pro Locksmith Tech with similarly named locksmith businesses such as Pro Locksmith LLC or prolocksmithllc.com
- Arrival times depend on service availability, traffic and location and are not guaranteed
